snippet.title: 07GORILLAS // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040880/07GORILLAS/

07GORILLAS is a top-down roguelike arena shooter game, you control one gorilla from a squad of seven break into "Foggy Zone" on a cleanup mission. Missions lasts less than 20 minutes, fight your way with powerful kung fu and tactical consumables, don't forget internal force enhancement.

Developed by
@Highway_404
